description: This file defines the Smarty_Internal_Method_CreateData class, which implements the createData method for the Smarty templating engine. It creates and returns a Smarty_Data object, optionally registering debugging data if debugging is enabled.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_CreateData
classes.description: Class providing the createData method to generate Smarty_Data objects for templates, with optional debugging registration.

methods.name: createData
methods.description: Creates a new Smarty_Data object associated with the given Smarty template object. Registers debugging data if debugging is enabled.
